# Security Policy

Do not open public GitHub issues for security vulnerabilities in this repository or its container images.

Report vulnerabilities by email to [security@gsa.gov](mailto:security@gsa.gov) with `collab-containers security vulnerability` in the subject line.

Include the affected component, reproduction steps if available, potential impact, and your contact information. The maintainers follow coordinated disclosure and will respond according to the timelines in the root [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
